preconditions.name: mech448_demotion_lever_live_and_excluding_both_arms
preconditions.description: The MECH-448 f_eligibility-demotion conversion constant (matched on BOTH arms) is ACTIVE on >= DEMOTION_ACTIVE_FRAC_FLOOR of P2 ticks AND it ACTUALLY EXCLUDES on the divergent e2_world_forward pool (mean f_eligibility_excluded_count > EXCLUDED_COUNT_FLOOR), on a majority of seeds in BOTH arms. An all-admit envelope (excluded_count==0; a flat-F pool) means the demotion did nothing -> the conversion constant is vacuous => substrate_not_ready_requeue (do NOT score the falsifier), NEVER a false weakens. Mirrors the V3-EXQ-689d READINESS(c) non-degeneracy gate.
preconditions.control: f_demotion envelope active-frac + excluded_count on both arms (matched lever)

preconditions.name: mech449_active_nogo_live_and_suppressing_both_arms
preconditions.description: The MECH-449 Go/No-Go eligibility constitution (matched on BOTH arms) is ACTIVE on >= NOGO_ACTIVE_FRAC_FLOOR of P2 ticks AND it ACTUALLY SUPPRESSES -- removes candidates from the F-eligible set (mean per-tick go_nogo_n_safety_nogo + go_nogo_n_soft_applied > NOGO_SUPPRESSED_FLOOR; the soft path is the MECH-260 perseveration No-Go fed by the dACC recency-share vector with use_dacc=True), on a majority of seeds in BOTH arms. An inert No-Go (nothing suppressed; the perseveration axis never crosses gng_perseveration_floor) means the active opponency leg did nothing -> the conversion constant is vacuous => substrate_not_ready_requeue (do NOT score the falsifier), NEVER a false weakens. Mirrors the V3-EXQ-689g go_nogo-actually-suppresses non-degeneracy gate.
preconditions.control: Go/No-Go constitution active-frac + suppressed-count on both arms (matched lever)

preconditions.name: context_partition_adequate_both_arms
preconditions.description: NEW (V3-EXQ-847, H4): the reef/open context partition itself is READABLE for a majority of seeds in BOTH arms -- n_reef_ticks >= MIN_CONTEXT_TICKS AND n_open_ticks >= MIN_CONTEXT_TICKS (context_scorable, ported from V3-EXQ-690). The 690 manifest showed this degenerates for some seeds (seed 44: n_reef_ticks=0 under 690's policy) purely from env-geometry trajectory variance, independent of the rule-apprehension manipulation. Below-floor on a majority of seeds means the H4 context-conditioned DV was never actually exercisable for those seeds -> exclude them from C2-context (the paired comparison below already restricts to jointly-scorable seeds); if fewer than a majority clear this in EITHER arm, the whole run self-routes substrate_not_ready_requeue (do NOT read a below-floor run as confirming OR refuting H4).
preconditions.control: SD-054 reef/open bipartite geometry, both arms (env config identical to 654j)

evidence_direction_note: V3-EXQ-847 ARC-062 GOV-FANOUT-1 Leg P-D (H4: measurement aliasing --context-conditioned mode-switch). DIAGNOSTIC, claim_ids=[]; brake-exempt (a different question from the same-claim P-A retest). Design source: REE_assembly/evidence/planning/arc_062_conversion_fanout_2026-07-29.md Section 2 Leg P-D, chip chip-20260729-arc062-pd-context-modeswitch. PREMISE CORRECTION (this build session): the plan doc's P-D design line names 'gated_policy routing', which Leg P-A's own erratum (same doc, appended 2026-07-31) found does NOT route the rule-apprehension/CRF channel (it identity-routes the unrelated GatedPolicy module output). This build OMITS that routing entirely -- P-D is a straight adaptation of the 654j matched stack (unchanged: SP-CEM + GAP-A e2_world_forward + MECH-448 demotion + MECH-449 active No-Go, all matched-stack constants on BOTH arms; swept variable use_candidate_rule_field) plus a NEW context-partitioned readout layered on top of the SAME P2 measurement window. GOV-REUSE-1 check: no existing manifest combines the reef/open partition (V3-EXQ-690's _is_reef_half/_tv_distance, ported verbatim) with the use_candidate_rule_field sweep -- 690's own swept variable is noise_floor_min_temperature, a different manipulation; not recoverable, proceeded to a new run. PRIMARY DV (NEW) = paired-by-seed lift in tv_context_divergence (TV distance between reef-context and open-context committed-class distributions) of ARM_ON over ARM_OFF, restricted to seeds context_scorable in BOTH arms (C1g, ported from 690's readiness pattern; guards the seed-44-style zero-reef-ticks degeneracy documented in failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-690_2026-06-20.md). C1 (readiness) = the INHERITED 654j non-vacuity gates C1a-f (class axis exercisable, GAP-A divergence, ARM_ON CRF matured >= 0.3, propagation non-vacuous, MECH-448 demotion live, MECH-449 active No-Go live and suppressing, all both arms) PLUS the NEW C1g context-partition-adequate gate (n_reef_ticks/n_open_ticks >= 10 on a majority of seeds in both arms). C2 (PRIMARY, H4 discriminator) = paired tv_context_divergence lift >= 0.05 on >= 2 context-scorable paired seeds. interpretation_label=substrate_not_ready_requeue. C1=False, C1g=True, C2_context=False, C2_pooled(reported, not load-bearing)=False. C1-fail (incl. C1g) self-routes substrate_not_ready_requeue -- the H4 question was never exercised, read as neither confirming nor refuting H4. C1-holds/C2-context-fail self-routes context_divergence_not_greater_arm_on_measurement_aliasing_ruled_out -- a pre-registered INFORMATIVE null (H4 refuted; strengthens the H2/H3 reading over a measurement artifact). C1-holds/C2-context-PASS self-routes context_conditioned_divergence_detected_motivates_evidence_repose -- H4 confirmed; motivates a NEW evidence-purpose re-pose of MECH-309/ARC-062 with the context DV as primary (a separate queue entry, not this one). ALL THREE branches are non_contributory (diagnostic, claim_ids=[]) -- this run PROMOTES / WEAKENS NOTHING by itself in any branch.

secondary_negative_control_not_load_bear.note: Within-class-representative entropy is a NEGATIVE CONTROL inherited from 654j: the rule bias is class-keyed (per-candidate summary first-action-keyed; compute_bias broadcasts one rule_state across K), so it cannot move within-class selection -> ARM_ON ~ ARM_OFF is EXPECTED here, confirming the rule-creator's signal lives in the committed-class axis (the axis both the pooled-marginal DV and the NEW context-partitioned DV read, at different granularities).

interpretation_grid.PASS_C1_C2_context_divergence_detected: The context partition was adequately exercised on a majority of seeds in BOTH arms (C1g), AND the differentiated rule_state's committed-class distribution diverges MORE strongly between the reef and open contexts than the collapsed legacy baseline's does, paired-by-seed, by at least TV_LIFT_MARGIN. H4 CONFIRMED: the pooled-marginal committed-class-entropy DV (654j's own primary, reported here as context) can be blind to a real context-conditioned effect. This is a DIAGNOSTIC finding (claim_ids=[]) -- it does NOT by itself support or weaken MECH-309/ARC-062. It motivates a NEW `evidence`-purpose re-pose of MECH-309/ARC-062 using the context-partitioned DV as primary (a separate /queue-experiment session), and it means a null pooled-DV result elsewhere in this fanout (P-A/654-lineage) should be read with more caution: it may be measuring the wrong axis, not the absence of an effect.
interpretation_grid.FAIL_C1_holds_C2_context_fails: The context partition was adequately exercised on a majority of seeds in BOTH arms (C1g -- the H4 question WAS actually tested), but the differentiated rule_state shows NO greater cross-context committed-class divergence than the collapsed legacy baseline, paired-by-seed. H4 REFUTED as the explanation for a pooled-DV null: the marginal-entropy DV was NOT merely aliasing a context-switch -- the conversion ceiling read elsewhere in this fanout is not a measurement artifact of THIS kind. Strengthens the H2 (F-dominance) / H3 (competence) reading. non_contributory (diagnostic; claim_ids=[], nothing to weaken). This is a pre-registered INFORMATIVE null, not a failed run -- GOV-FANOUT-1's stated price for an early, un-confounded answer.
interpretation_grid.FAIL_C1_substrate_not_ready_requeue: Either the inherited 654j substrate-readiness gates (C1a-f: class axis exercisable, GAP-A divergence, ARM_ON CRF matured, propagation non-vacuous, MECH-448 demotion live, MECH-449 active No-Go live and suppressing) were not met, OR (C1g, NEW) the reef/open context partition itself could not be READ on a majority of seeds in either arm (n_reef_ticks or n_open_ticks below MIN_CONTEXT_TICKS -- the seed-44-style environmental-degeneracy lesson from V3-EXQ-690). The H4 question was never actually exercised in this run -- do NOT read this as confirming OR refuting H4. Route to substrate enrichment / re-queue with a wider seed set if C1g specifically is the blocker.
